summary: Validated pricing copy across LandingPage/AuthPage/PricingPage and Practice Branding feature (backend + advisor frontend). 11/11 backend branding tests pass (logo upload returns base64 data URI, GET reflects it, DELETE clears, empty/extension/size errors all 400, individuals 403 on POST and DELETE, PUT branding regression OK). Frontend pricing copy is correct everywhere with no stale R1,299/R2,289. Branding settings UI works for advisor (all data-testids present, save toast, logo upload populates preview, preset swatches work). IRP5 vault list and digest preview regression endpoints both reachable for individuals.
action_items: RECOMMENDED MANUAL VERIFY: confirm RoleGate truly blocks an individual at /branding-settings via real UI login (register individual via /auth, sign in, then visit /branding-settings). My token-swap approach in Playwright did not reliably reset AuthContext, so I cannot definitively confirm the frontend RoleGate redirect — backend 403 is confirmed though, so feature is safe.
critical_code_review_comments: BrandingSettings.jsx uses window.location.origin for API_URL fallback when not on localhost — fine but a bit redundant; prefer single env-driven constant.
reports.py logo upload trusts extension from filename for MIME — acceptable for advisor self-upload but could be hardened by sniffing magic bytes (low priority).
Frontend BrandingSettings has no client-side validation of color hex format beyond what the color input accepts; minor.
